model_annotation: The line plot displays the development of three economic policy indices—Wirtschaftspolitik (economic policy) overall, Finanzpolitik (fiscal policy), and Handelspolitik (trade policy)—from 2016 to 2024. The x-axis represents the years, ranging from 2016 to 2024. The y-axis on the left, labeled "Index," ranges from 0 to 1,000 and corresponds to the Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt and Finanzpolitik indices, which are plotted using a black solid line and a blue solid line, respectively. The y-axis on the right, also labeled "Index," ranges from 0 to 9,000 and corresponds to the Handelspolitik index, which is plotted using a magenta solid line. The Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt index (black line) starts at approximately 100 in 2016, fluctuates with a peak around 500 in 2020, and then declines to about 100 by 2024. The Finanzpolitik index (blue line) follows a similar pattern, starting at around 100, peaking at approximately 450 in 2020, and then decreasing to about 100 by 2024. The Handelspolitik index (magenta line) remains relatively low and stable until 2020, then shows a sharp increase, reaching a peak of approximately 8,500 in 2024.
